perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.desc: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.desc: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.desc: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 108 from 9 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/20WqdTYGB2K4SfWYePZWo1?si=0c706567ddea4e10) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE / PvE-Boss / PvE-BossSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for sustained boss damage. "Suspectum" is a Latin adjective meaning "mistrusted" and - fun fact - is also the specific name for the Gila monster (Heloderma suspectum). In Destiny 2, this is a precision frame (so you can ignore recoil stats) stasis fusion rifle. The Veist Stinger origin trait, even post-nerf - is still handy for a partial reload and and gunfeel boosts. Try to improve handling a little with the barrel perk, and then in the battery perk slot, Ionized Battery plus Backup Mag is the only way to get to the maximum of 7 shots. That means, with three reserves mods and a fully procced Envious Assassin in the first trait column you'll have 21 shots of your 23 total in your battery (and if Veist Singer procs, you'll run out before reloading). You can't get Bait and Switch, but Firing Line's +20% damage in a fireteam is perfectly respectable and doesn't need reproccing, or Precision Instrument tops out at +25% per shot once you hit six crits in a row. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 108 from 9 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/20WqdTYGB2K4SfWYePZWo1?si=0c706567ddea4e10) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-MajorSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for Champion Control, particularly with stasis fragments. "Suspectum" is a Latin adjective meaning "mistrusted" and - fun fact - is also the specific name for the Gila monster (Heloderma suspectum). In Destiny 2, this is a precision frame (so you can ignore recoil stats) stasis fusion rifle. The Veist Stinger origin trait, even post-nerf - is still handy for a partial reload and andy gunfeel boosts. Try to improve handling a little with the barrel perk, and then in the battery perk slot, as you're looking for speed rather than raw damage, Accelerated Coils gets your shot off a little faster. Envious Assassin in the first trait perk column can overflow the battery to 18 shots, 15 of which will proc Chill Clip in the second column, so you'll be able to disrupt Overloads with a single shot or stun Unstoppables with two at a safe distance. Recommended MW: Charge Time or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 108 from 9 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/20WqdTYGB2K4SfWYePZWo1?si=0c706567ddea4e10) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-MajorSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for Champion Control, particularly with stasis fragments. "Suspectum" is a Latin adjective meaning "mistrusted" and - fun fact - is also the specific name for the Gila monster (Heloderma suspectum). In Destiny 2, this is a precision frame (so you can ignore recoil stats) stasis fusion rifle. The Veist Stinger origin trait, even post-nerf - is still handy for a partial reload and andy gunfeel boosts. Try to improve handling a little with the barrel perk, and then in the battery perk slot, as you're looking for speed rather than raw damage, Accelerated Coils gets your shot off a little faster. Although not entirely serious, Suspectum is one of only two LFRs that can roll with both stasis synergy trait perks - Headstone in the first column and Chill Clip in the second. You'll still be able to disrupt Overloads with a single shot or stun Unstoppables with two at a safe distance, and to generate stasis crystals on a crit kill, to use with stasis fragments. Recommended MW: Charge Time or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Suspectum-4fr has some of the best perks on a linear fusion rifle. Envious Assassin with Firing Line for damage or even Fourth Time’s the Charm for more ammo back, and that’s not even taking into consideration the origin trait also granting some ammo back automatically. If you wanted to fire a linear fusion near indefinitely you now can. Chill Clip and Headstone give the best Stasis synergy if you wanted to go that route." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Over in PvP you’re really looking at Backup Plan for a faster shot and either High Ground or Chill Clip for damage / easier follow ups because the target is slowed. There are better linear fusion rifles for consistency or kill chaining." Recommended MW: Charge Time.
